info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, podsFront, loopX, loopWidth, Eye, eyeOffset, eyeVelglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChangeon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  Eye = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 1)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  eyeOffset = 4  this.locZ = 103  eyeVel = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.locH = Xpos    eyeVel = eyeVel - (eyeOffset * 0.025)    eyeOffset = eyeOffset + eyeVel    Eye.locH = this.locH + eyeOffset    Eye.locV = this.locV - eyeOffset  end ifend
